title: Random Trio #06 (임산부+이레즈미+바디페인팅)

#2 (Irezumi): THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, mid 40s goddess, BBW bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — most massive full-figure BBW body ever at absolute maximum in every dimension, hips so wide beyond proportion dominating the entire frame, bust so enormous overwhelming gravity, waist deeply snatched despite impossible volume, loose beach waves mid-length tousled — full body chrysanthemum irezumi covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE. Bold black ink outlines — BLAZING DEEP GOLD chrysanthemum blooms enormous layered petals full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID EMERALD leaf lattice filling every gap, NO airbrush NO gradient wash. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme BBW bombshell silhouette ever displayed. #3 (Bodypaint): a real adult Korean woman in her late 50s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores, fair porcelain skin, two round red yeonji blush circles painted on the cheeks and a small round red gonji dot at the centre of the forehead, clearly defined dark brows, softly lined eyes with bright real catchlights, small vivid red lips, a serene, dignified expression, demure and soft, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in twin-tail, real living eyes. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Pose: back fully to camera. Footwear: extreme silver platform high-heel mules.

MANDATORY pure pitch black void background only, absolutely NO studio backdrop NO texture NO grey NO gradient. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all bodypaint/pregnant/irezumi/stained-glass/gold-leaf/botanical women from one side, realistic photographic grain where applicable, extreme high-gloss oil on maximalist tracks — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render; any UV Neon track woman additionally lit by her own dedicated UV blacklight spot. Pattern density maximum on all 3, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 4:5 aspect ratio.
